review.notes:
No login needed; all journal features work offline. All entries are stored only locally on the device. There is no server.

What makes this journal different – please try these four features:
1. Time capsule: tap “Write”, write a few lines, then under “Seal as a time capsule” choose 1 month / 6 months / 1 year / 5 years and save. The entry becomes locked (lock card in the list, a “Time capsules” card on the start page); it can't be opened, searched or exported until the opening day, when a local notification arrives.
2. Voice notes: in the entry editor tap the microphone next to “Photo”, speak, tap again to stop. Clips can be played back in the entry (up to 5 minutes each, stored only on the device).
3. Mood year: the “Look back” tab shows every day of the year as a coloured square (“year in pixels”) plus patterns – best and hardest weekday, tags that go with good days, mood distribution.
4. Journal as a book: Settings → Data → “Export as a book (PDF)” creates a typeset PDF (cover, entries, moods, photos) for this month, this year or all entries, and opens the share sheet.

The app shows Google AdMob ads (banner and occasionally an interstitial after saving an entry); in the EEA a Google consent form appears first, then the App Tracking Transparency prompt.

Optional: Settings → Security sets a 4-digit PIN, then Face ID can be turned on. The daily reminder is under Settings → Reminder. The app follows the device language (14 languages, including Arabic right-to-left).

In-app purchase “Remove ads” (non-consumable): Settings → Ads → Remove ads. “Restore purchase” is in the same place.
